blocks.text: Incomplete dominance mein koi allele doosre par poori tarah dominant nahi hota, is liye heterozygote walidain ke darmiyan ka phenotype dikhata hai. Japani four-o'clock paudon mein surkh phool (RR) x safaid phool (WW) se sab heterozygous gulabi phool (RW) wale bachche bante hain, jis se pata chalta hai ke na surkh allele R aur na safaid allele W poori tarah dominant hai.

blocks.alt: Four-o'clock ke phool. Walidain: surkh phool (RR) x safaid phool (WW); gametes R, R aur W, W; teer chaar gulabi F1 paudon tak jate hain, genotypes RW, phenotype sab gulabi. F1 x F1: do gulabi phool; gametes R, W aur R, W; teer chaar F2 paudon tak: aik surkh, do gulabi, aik safaid.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 18.3 mein F2 ke chaaron paudon ke neeche genotype 'RW' chhapa hai, halanke phenotypes 1 surkh : 2 gulabi : 1 safaid likhe hain. Yeh ghalat hai: surkh phool RR, dono gulabi RW, aur safaid WW hai. Hamare khaake mein sahih genotypes RR, RW, RW, WW diye gaye hain. Teer dekhein: har F2 paude ko aik gamete pehle F1 se aur aik doosre se milta hai.
Do gulabi paude (RW x RW) milane se surkh (RR), gulabi (RW) aur safaid (WW) 1:2:1 mein aate hain, yaani incomplete dominance mein phenotype ki nisbat genotype ki nisbat jaisi hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Gulabi four-o'clock (RW) ko surkh (RR) se milaya. (a) Surkh, (b) gulabi ka ehtimal, (c) gulabi aur surkh ki nisbat nikalein.
blocks.explanation: RR sirf R deta; RW R ya W barabar. (a) RR surkh = 1/2. (b) RW gulabi = 1/2. (c) Gulabi : surkh = 1 : 1.

items: RW x RW: 1 surkh : 2 gulabi : 1 safaid.
